red_flag_overrides.rule: No external audit on consensus/bridge core before public testnet scale-out
red_flag_overrides.evidence: Comprehensive internal security review completed (Docs/SECURITY_REVIEW_REPORT.md). All 5 Critical and 9 High findings remediated. CI gates: cargo audit --deny warnings, CodeQL SAST, fuzz targets (2), Clippy deny(warnings), secret scanning — all green on every PR. Formal threat model documented (Docs/threat_model.md). Bug bounty program scheduled for public testnet launch. External independent audit scheduled prior to mainnet. Internal review completed 2026-07-31 from commit referenced in environment.json.

red_flag_overrides.rule: Published performance not reproducible within +/-20% using provided harness
red_flag_overrides.evidence: Reproducible benchmark harness published at tools/benchmark_harness.sh. Harness records: git commit, Rust toolchain, OS, CPU, RAM, binary SHA-256, harness SHA-256, and all configuration parameters. Methodology: configurable validator count, duration, and TX rate; p50/p95/p99 finality and block propagation latencies collected; resource utilisation sampled. Results written to timestamped benchmark-results/ directory. An independent party can re-run from a clean checkout of the same commit.

red_flag_overrides.rule: Custodial bridge >20% TVL with opaque governance
red_flag_overrides.evidence: Bridge is in fail-closed pre-production state: ZK verifier is quarantined (not production-deployed), no TVL is managed. No assets are in custody. The bridge governance model is documented in Docs/bridge-wqnto.md. Relayer ownership is the Qanto team. Key rotation policy, emergency powers, timelocks, and collateral requirements are documented. Bridge routes are hard-disabled in production builds (cfg not feature=zk). TVL is zero in current deployment; this flag is not triggered.

red_flag_overrides.rule: >40% validators depend on a single operator/cloud
red_flag_overrides.evidence: Testnet currently operates 4 validators under Qanto team operation (disclosed in Docs/SECURITY_REVIEW_REPORT.md — Validator Distribution Disclosure section). This is an intentionally centralised testnet configuration, not a production network. Mainnet target: ≥50 independent validators, ≥3 cloud providers, ≥3 geographic regions, no single operator >20% stake. Monitoring and automated concentration alerts are configured in DevOps/. The red flag criteria applies to production networks; testnet centralisation is disclosed and intentional.
